label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
raw_output: When a business sends customer data to a country without proper data protection standards, this applies during data transfers, especially when the customer has given clear consent or when the transfer is needed for a contract or legal reasons. It involves the business and the customer.
